data.one_liner: Sync and manage app files in iCloud storage for iOS and macOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides an interface to upload, download, delete, rename, and move files within iCloud storage containers. It supports path filtering, timeout handling, progress tracking, and live stream updates for file modifications.
use_when: You need to back up or sync app documents and data to iCloud on iOS and macOS.
You want to monitor live updates or track upload/download progress of cloud files.
avoid_when: You are building for Android or web platforms where iCloud is unavailable.
You need a cross-platform local database or key-value store rather than cloud file sync.
strengths: Supports path filtering and timeout options for metadata queries.
Provides progress tracking callbacks and live stream updates for file changes.
Comprehensive API for file operations (upload, delete, rename, move, replace).
weaknesses: Limited to Apple platforms (iOS and macOS).
Requires manual configuration of iCloud Container IDs, App IDs, and Apple Developer entitlements.
data.setup_notes: Requires an Apple Developer account, configuring an iCloud Container ID, enabling the iCloud capability in Apple Developer portal, and setting up entitlements in Xcode.
